actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.

official_title: To amend the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 to prohibit the Secretary of Agriculture from approving retail food stores to accept benefits from recipients of supplemental nutrition assistance through on-line transactions for delivery orders, and for other purposes.
